headline: AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton was reported to have called President Trump's leadership on AI 'appalling' and to have questioned whether he would put humanity ahead of enriching his family.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: only a short video blurb, with no date, setting or direct quote beyond one word, and a similar Hinton warning ran in our 5 Oct edition.
importance_line: A prominent AI scientist's criticism of the president adds to the argument over who should set AI safety rules, as did his reported warning that Trump misunderstands AI in our 5 Oct 2026 edition, but the item is a short video blurb that gives no date, setting or full quotes.
summary: Oneindia reports in a video item that Geoffrey Hinton, widely called a godfather of AI, described President Trump's leadership on AI as 'appalling' and questioned whether Trump would choose to protect humanity or to make his family rich.
notes: Oneindia video blurb only; the date and venue of Hinton's remarks are not stated and may be older. See our 5 Oct 2026 edition (NewsBytes) for a similar Hinton warning.
